mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not positive and significant (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value exceeding 236.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 236.0) are not significantly negative compared to baseline (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 900) signals an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in triggered instances (UNRATE < 5.0 AND HOUST > 900.0) are not significantly negative compared to baseline (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 236.0) signals the central bank's commitment to fight inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 2.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 236.0) are not significantly negative compared to baseline (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
